description.p: AstroGods starts from the position of the planets at the moment of your birth to offer you a portrait of who you are: your way of loving, thinking, acting. You can explore compatibility with another person or understand what energies characterize a period of your life.

AstroGods parte dalla posizione dei pianeti nel momento della tua nascita per offrirti un ritratto di chi sei: il tuo modo di amare, pensare, agire. Puoi esplorare la compatibilità con un'altra persona o capire quali energie caratterizzano un periodo della tua vita.

Here, Astrology is taken seriously. The astronomical calculations are the most precise available, the methodology adheres to the original Egyptian tradition, the interpretations are in-depth. No generic horoscopes: each reading goes into the detail of your unique configuration.

Qui l'Astrologia si fa sul serio. I calcoli astronomici sono i più precisi disponibili, la metodologia aderisce alla tradizione egizia originale, le interpretazioni sono approfondite. Niente oroscopi generici: ogni lettura entra nel dettaglio della tua configurazione unica.

Your first birth chart reading is completely free. Additional birth charts require a Standard subscription (from 1.99 €/month). Synastry (compatibility analysis) and transit readings require a Premium subscription (from 2.99 €/month). All subscriptions include a 7-day free trial.

La prima lettura del tema natale è completamente gratuita. Temi natali aggiuntivi richiedono un abbonamento Standard (da 1,99 €/mese). Sinastrie (analisi di compatibilità) e letture dei transiti richiedono un abbonamento Premium (da 2,99 €/mese). Tutti gli abbonamenti includono una prova gratuita di 7 giorni.

description.p: On iPhone and iPad, managing your subscription now opens the Apple subscription sheet. Selected options now keep their highlight color.
Small fixes to keep the app running smoothly.
Small fixes to keep the app running smoothly.

On iPhone and Mac you can sign in with Apple and subscribe through the App Store. Change your email or password from settings, or add a password to a Google or Apple account. Readings follow the gender you choose, or stay neutral if you prefer not to say. Your birth charts are visible only to you, and readings no longer send your names to the AI. Please log in again after updating. Profile pictures and charts created without an account are gone.

Subscription checks and payments work properly again. Email horoscope settings and dialogs now fit better on narrow phones. On iOS, pages now start below the top bar, and titles are centered on every device.
Small fixes to keep the app running smoothly.

If you were born during a clock change, you can now pick which hour you mean. Charts for births before modern time zones are now more accurate. The Codex adds articles on precession and house systems, with interactive diagrams. Tap a citation in the Codex to read the original passage. New floating navigation bar and Google sign in on iPhone.
Success screen after subscription. Reorganized navigation in side menu. Clickable links in Codex. Subscription management improvements.
You can now regenerate readings in your preferred language. Saved transits now appear in saved analyses. Fixed authentication workflow bugs.
Updated terms and conditions and privacy policy. Fixed a registration issue. Birth chart is now automatically generated after registration.
